BRENTWOOD, Tenn., Jan.  31, 2019  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Tractor Supply Company (NASDAQ: TSCO), the largest rural lifestyle retail chain in the United States, today announced financial results for its fourth quarter and fiscal year ended December 29, 2018.

Key Highlights

Fourth Quarter Comparable Store Sales Increased 5.7%; Fourth Quarter Net Sales Increased 9.2%Fiscal Year Comparable Store Sales Increased 5.1%; Fiscal Year Net Sales Increased 9.0%Fourth Quarter Diluted EPS Increased 27.6% to $1.

headline: Tractor Supply and FFA Seeking Grant Applications
summary:
